These issues cause wrong output shapes, validation surprises, and failing serialization.","diagnosed_skills":[{"path":"dialogue-graph/SKILL.md","confidence":0.86,"diagnosis":"Edge creation/export guidance is inconsistent with the implementation: examples use Edge(source,target,...) while the serialized edge dict uses {\"from\",\"to\",\"text\"}. The required JSON wire format is not explicitly locked down, and the special terminal target \"End\" convention is unclear (whether an explicit End node is required or edges may target \"End\" without a node). The visualization snippet is also syntactically broken (missing closing parenthesis), reducing trust in the doc and confusing usage.","repair_instruction":"Revise the Adding Edges + Export sections to explicitly define the canonical JSON schema: nodes as {\"id\",\"text\",\"speaker\",\"type\"} and edges as {\"from\",\"to\",\"text\"} (with text optional). Update code examples so the constructor arguments and the serialized keys are clearly mapped (e.g., explain that Edge(source,target) serializes to from/to). Standardize and document the \"End\" convention in one place: either require adding an explicit Node(id=\"End\", type=\"end\") and require all edge targets exist, OR explicitly allow edges to target the reserved string \"End\" without a corresponding node and state that validation permits it. Fix the visualization example to valid Python (close parentheses) and ensure all snippets are consistent and non-truncated."},{"path":"dialogue-graph/scripts/dialogue_graph.py","confidence":0.8,"diagnosis":"Graph.to_json() is broken/truncated (returns an undefined identifier), so consumers cannot reliably export JSON. validate() contains an implicit special-case allowing missing target only when target == \"End\", which may contradict task expectations unless the same convention is clearly documented and consistently supported across export/usage.","repair_instruction":"Implement Graph.to_json() correctly (e.g., `return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)`). Ensure the file is complete (not truncated) and serialization matches the documented schema (edges emitted as from/to/text). Decide on and enforce a consistent End policy: either (a) remove the special-case and require an explicit End node, or (b) keep the special-case but treat \"End\" as a reserved terminal everywhere (docs/tests/examples) so validation and consumers align."}],"unselected_skills":[]}
